inputs.text: Vertical medium shot at the bedroom desk. Lin Xiaoyu ends the scam, preserving evidence and blocking the contact while the phone display remains completely hidden. Tears show grief rather than helplessness; her posture is determined. Lighting begins transitioning from cold blue toward warm amber. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll, natural hands, no visible screen, no generated text. Animate only the following controlled action. Start: exactly one phone lies flat and face-down on the wooden desk, with its matte back and camera lenses facing upward. Action: the phone remains completely motionless and face-down; Lin Xiaoyu draws both hands back by one centimeter and exhales. End: the same phone remains face-down in exactly the same position while both hands rest beside it. Motion is extremely small. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. Only subtle lip, eye and shoulder movement. The phone must never rotate, flip, move, or expose its screen.
